newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European bunkers steady, Greek and Durban shortage.
newsitem.headline: European bunkers steady, Greek and Durban shortage.

text.p: European bunker prices were steady on Tuesday with demand still low, dealers said.
Piraeus and Durban continued to experience supply problems.
Rotterdam 380 CST fuel oil was still quoted around $89 fob as the barge market remained at a standstill for most of the day.
Total ARA bunker demand surpassed 10,000 tonnes by most estimates, but only slightly. Suppliers said they had noted some improvements in the afternoon.
"It's been a better day (than Monday), but not by very much," one supplier said.
Hamburg prices softened a shade from Monday's high levels, but still failed to attract many buyers.
Mediterranean bunker prices were again little changed. France returned to work after a public holiday on Monday.
Greek supply was very short with problems at the state-owned refinery.

Durban prices were steady, but dealers said supplies remained tight after the rupturing of one of the underground pipelines supplying the harbour at the weekend. Some said nothing was available for delivery until July 21.
